summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant sit right on top of your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The harder part is that comfort can sometimes become the goal instead of closeness. You may avoid difficult conversations, smooth things over too quickly, or tell yourselves that everything is fine because neither of you wants to disrupt the good feeling. But relationships need more than sweetness to grow. They need room for honesty too.
advice: Enjoy how easy this feels. Let yourself take in the affection. Just remember that real intimacy is not only about keeping things pleasant. It is also about trusting the connection enough to tell the truth when something matters.
